name: Lease End Live
tagline: Straight answers on lease buyouts from Joe, Managing Director at Champion Auto Finance.

host.name: Joe
host.title: Managing Director, Champion Auto Finance
host.bio: Joe is the managing director at Champion Auto Finance, which helps drivers across the country finance the purchase of the car they already lease. On Lease End Live he answers the questions people actually ask at the end of a lease, in plain English.

disclosure: Champion Auto Finance is a NJ DOBI-licensed financing partner, not a lender, coordinating lease buyout financing for drivers nationwide. Approvals and terms are subject to lender underwriting. Nothing on this site or in these episodes is legal, tax or financial advice.

shows.title: The Lease End Minute
shows.subtitle: One lease-end tip, in about a minute.
shows.description: The Lease End Minute is a quick, practical tip for anyone whose car lease is ending: payoff quotes, residual values, mileage, equity and the questions to ask before you hand back the keys. Hosted by Joe, Managing Director at Champion Auto Finance.
shows.seo_title: The Lease End Minute: 60-Second Lease Buyout Tips (Podcast)

shows.title: Keys or Keep
shows.subtitle: Lease buyout questions, answered.
shows.description: Keys or Keep takes real-world lease-end questions and works through the one decision that matters: hand back the keys, or keep the car. Each episode Joe, Managing Director at Champion Auto Finance, walks through the numbers, the process and the reasoning behind a lease buyout.
shows.seo_title: Keys or Keep: Lease Buyout Questions Answered (Podcast)
keywords: should I buy my leased car

production_note: The Lease End Minute and Keys or Keep are produced by Champion Auto Finance and hosted by Joe, Managing Director.
question_note: Listener questions are composites based on the kinds of questions people ask us; names and details are changed.
